subject: Staggered arrival windows + hybrid handoffs for Nov 9 exec workshop

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Staggered arrival windows + hybrid handoffs for Nov 9 exec workshop

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for confirming Nov 9 in London for the executive workshop. To keep the day smooth for both in-person and remote execs we propose staggered arrival windows and two explicit hybrid handoff points (post-keynote & lunch). High-level ask: can you confirm your top four VIP attendees and their preferred arrival windows below by Monday? We need to lock shuttles/briefing rooms and seed calendar slots.

Proposed arrival windows (local time):
- Window A: 08:00–09:30 — VIP dropoff + private briefing room (short 20-min pre-brief)
- Window B: 09:45–11:15 — Main arrival for product sessions, AV check
- Window C: 13:00–14:00 — Afternoon arrivals / late flights with quick onboarding

Hybrid handoffs (to support remote execs joining seamlessly):
1) 10:45 — post-keynote quick handoff: in-room lead to confirm video feed and mute policy; 10-min buffer to switch presenters.
2) 14:45 — post-lunch handoff: rotate in-room moderator and ensure remote Q&A queue is open.

Attachments: venue_floorplan.pdf (floor assignments + green room), arrival-shuttle-schedule.pdf (draft).

If Novus prefers a single consolidated arrival block we can do that, but given the number of external execs and differing flight options this staggered approach reduces lobby congestion and keeps AV/tech checks tidy.

Next steps: Elena/Tom — please reply with attendee list + arrival window preference; Marissa / Vivek — please confirm vendor/shuttle availability and who owns the in-room moderator role.

Thanks,
Priyom
